## SetCookieOptions.serverDate property

The value of the HTTP `Date` response header that carried this `Set-Cookie` (either a date string or a `Date`<!-- -->). It is used for diagnostic information only: the resulting debug object reports the clock skew between the server and the local clock and what the expiry would be if the server's clock were trusted. It never changes the expiry that tough-cookie enforces. Only meaningful together with `expiryDebug: true`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
serverDate?: string | Date | undefined;
```
